why: In a side mirror the Z flips left to right, so its slanted line now goes from top-left to bottom-right, like a backwards Z. That is option 1. Option 2 is the Z turned on its side, which is a rotation.
trick: Remember: mirror image of Z looks like S-shaped backwards Z; of S it looks like Z.
